records.title: Security Incident Update #2
records.summary: Binance says it will cover incident losses through SAFU and corporate treasury; more than $6.34B allocated, with $5B already held in affected token assets and approximately $3B frozen on-chain. It plans an initial PoR snapshot within 12 hours and publication by 2026-11-02; withdrawal restoration is phased and subject to security checks. At the 2026-10-31T11:07Z cutoff the 07:33Z snapshot target had elapsed, but no public result was located. No XRP-specific replenishment amount is disclosed.
records.methodology: Official Binance Support announcement, publication timestamp and stated milestones.
records.limitations: Company statements are not an independent audit. Snapshot execution, asset-level replenishment and same-time customer liabilities remain unverified.

records.title: Binance plans to complete proof-of-reserves snapshot by 3:33 p.m. today and begin phased withdrawal restoration by 1:33 p.m. tomorrow
records.summary: Verified Binance News account restates the first PoR snapshot target as 15:33 UTC+8 on October 31 (07:33 UTC) and phased withdrawal-restoration target as 13:33 UTC+8 on November 1 (05:33 UTC). The post says results are due November 2. At retrieval the snapshot target had elapsed; the withdrawal target was still in the future.
records.methodology: Verified Binance account post, timezone conversion from UTC+8 to UTC.
records.limitations: A target is not evidence that a snapshot was taken or withdrawals were restored. No public snapshot result was located in this run.

records.title: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets, reserve data shows
records.summary: CoinDesk reports Binance 14, an Ethereum hot wallet at the centre of the attack, appears in Binance's October 1 PoR address list. It reports 1.26B USDT and 89,475 ETH in that wallet at the snapshot, among 37 assets. CoinDesk estimates about 204,500 ETH drained from Binance 14 and Binance 16 could leave Binance's ETH backing near 94% until replenishment. This evidence is Ethereum-specific and does not crosswalk the five XRPL incident source wallets into Binance's XRP reserve set.
records.methodology: CoinDesk review of Binance's October 1 public reserve-address data and Ethereum transaction records.
records.limitations: Secondary analysis, not a new same-time PoR or liability reconciliation. Binance 14 is an Ethereum address; do not extrapolate this finding to XRPL wallets or XRP reserves.

records.title: Proof of Reserves — methodology and address ownership
records.summary: Binance's PoR page says reserve addresses include wallets it owns in hot and cold storage, with address-ownership verification, a snapshot of user balances and Merkle-tree/zk-SNARK verification. The parsed public page did not expose a new post-incident snapshot or current token-level reserve data.
records.methodology: Official Binance PoR methodology page, sections on address ownership, user-balance snapshot and Merkle/zk-SNARK verification.
records.limitations: Methodology is not a substitute for the pending post-incident snapshot, independent assurance or a completed same-time asset/liability crosswalk.

records.title: XRP futures market data — 2026-10-31 10:00 UTC snapshot
records.summary: At its stated 10:00 UTC update, TradRadar reports XRP mark price $1.2483 (-0.23% 24h), OI $1.85B across seven exchanges (+1.24% 24h), OI-weighted funding +0.0077% per eight hours, at least $1.91M liquidations across five exchanges ($1.36M long, $548.39K short), and a 3.58 long/short account ratio (78.2% long). Exchange OI: Binance $415.49M, Bybit $336.02M, Gate $276.53M, MEXC $271.47M, Bitget $246.60M, Hyperliquid $193.93M and OKX $110.70M.
records.methodology: TradRadar states it collects public XRP perpetual-futures data from seven venues; figures are delayed 15 minutes. Liquidations cover five exchanges and are incomplete lower bounds. Long/short is account count ratio weighted by OI.
records.limitations: One provider and one snapshot. Account share is not notional exposure; OI contract universe and aggregation require reconciliation against independent providers. Not a directional forecast.

records.title: XRP ETF flows by fund — data through 2026-10-29 session
records.summary: The dashboard covers five US spot XRP funds through the October 29 session. It reports +$8.4M net flow on October 29, +$8.4M across the last seven sessions (October 22–29), +$98.9M over 30 sessions, and $1.73B cumulative net inflow since November 14, 2025; it also reports +989.1M XRP net flow at each day's prices. The provider says net assets, holdings and fees are not published and cumulative flow is not fund size or current holdings.
records.methodology: Provider's session-by-session flow series across five tickers; cumulative net flow is contributions less redemptions at each day's prices.
records.limitations: No AUM or current holdings. Latest session is October 29, not October 30 or 31. Flow is not necessarily same-day spot execution or net external capital; redemptions may be arbitrage unwinds.

records.title: Complete open pull-request inventory against current main
records.summary: GitHub REST pages 1–2 returned 183 open PRs: 173 drafts and 10 ready for review. Of 181 PRs based on main, three target current main SHA 72da1896c17be59815d21d9f7065f65f307a46d8 and 178 have stale base SHAs; two target non-main branches. Current-base PRs are #1408, #1409 and #1410.
records.methodology: GitHub REST pulls endpoint, state=open, two pages of 100, exact base-SHA comparison with main.
records.limitations: Point-in-time inventory. Stale base alone does not prove conflict. Every proposal requires individual changed-path, exact-head and merge-result validation.

records.title: Current-main scheduled writer and credential-workflow source audit
records.summary: Main SHA 72da1896 still contains three high-risk automation paths: Cross Analysis has contents:write and commits/pushes sentiment/knowledge artifacts; Scheduler Tick has contents:write and actions:write, can dispatch queued workflows and commits queue changes; Databricks token rotation accepts a new_token input and interpolates it into a shell command for gh secret set before a deployment dispatch. The Cross Analysis scheduled run at 10:52 UTC wrote a timestamp-only sentiment_shift artifact despite zero XRP/BTC observations. PRs #1408, #1407 and #1405 propose safer replacements but are unmerged.
records.methodology: Read-only fetch of current main workflow files, latest main commit and related PR diffs.
records.limitations: No workflow was dispatched and no secret was read or rotated. Proposed fixes are not active on main. Branch-protection details remain inaccessible through the tested read endpoint.

records.title: PR #1410 fixed-horizon XRP ledger and baseline chronology correction
records.summary: PR #1410 head 2893d5bb2a30f8c01cca45deb96720402850544e extends the fixed-horizon ledger to reject a baseline whose trained_through_utc is later than computed_at_utc, even when both timestamps precede the forecast cutoff. A regression test reproduces that leakage condition. Exact-head CI 41195487945 passed 375 tests plus 8 subtests; fail-closed gate 41195487892 passed with merging disabled. PR remains draft, open and unmerged on current main base 72da1896.
records.methodology: Direct source inspection, targeted code/test append, GitHub commit diff, exact-head CI job logs and gate job.
records.limitations: This is a timestamp-integrity ledger, not model training, walk-forward validation, calibration, drift detection or shadow trading. OS file locks are local-filesystem only, not distributed-runner coordination.

records.title: PR #1409 entity-sentiment and co-occurrence semantic qualification
records.summary: PR #1409 labels entity sentiment and co-occurrence outputs as all-available-history, no timestamp filter, no deduplication and no source-independence adjustment; it explicitly marks them exploratory-only and not predictive. Exact-head CI 41194688933 and fail-closed gate 41194688938 passed. PR remains draft, open and unmerged on current main.
records.methodology: Source/test inspection and GitHub exact-head workflow run inventory.
records.limitations: The proposal limits claims but does not yet implement temporal filtering, syndicated-source deduplication, source-independence weighting or entity-level causal relevance.

records.title: PR #1408 Cross Analysis writer quarantine and approval push no-op
records.summary: PR #1408 changes Cross Analysis to contents:read, disables persisted checkout credentials, uploads generated outputs as bounded artifacts and adds an explicit no-permission push no-op to the approval workflow. Exact-head CI 41194594784 and fail-closed gate 41194594731 passed; push no-op run 41194591319 succeeded. PR remains draft, open and unmerged.
records.methodology: PR diff, focused workflow safety tests and exact-head GitHub Actions runs.
records.limitations: Fix is not active on main. Manual approval workflow_dispatch has not been tested. Artifact-only output does not preserve direct tracked-file/Pages publishing without a separately authorized publisher.

records.title: PR #1407 read-only scheduler queue audit
records.summary: PR #1407 replaces scheduler tick with a scheduled/manual read-only queue audit, removes contents:write and actions:write, does not dispatch queued workflows and uploads a bounded audit artifact. Exact-head CI 41193759171 and fail-closed gate 41193759217 passed. PR remains draft, open and one commit behind current main.
records.methodology: PR diff, focused scheduler workflow tests and exact-head GitHub Actions runs.
records.limitations: The proposal pauses autonomous dispatch rather than implementing a durable external queue. It is not active on main.

records.title: PR #1405 Databricks token rotation workflow safety
records.summary: PR #1405 removes the new_token input, shell interpolation, repository secret mutation and deployment dispatch; it emits ROTATION_NOT_PERFORMED and requires authorized manual secret management. Exact-head CI 41192102065 and fail-closed gate 41192102051 passed. PR remains draft, open and one commit behind current main; unsafe workflow remains on main.
records.methodology: Workflow diff, focused secret-input safety tests and exact-head CI/gate.
records.limitations: No token was read, rotated or deployed. The security correction is proposed only and not active on main.

records.title: PR #1402 approval-workflow push no-op counterexample
records.summary: PR #1402's branch push test 41184448544 succeeded with a no-op job; CI 41184451373 and fail-closed gate 41184451359 passed. Main still produced push-event zero-job failures in later runs; exact root cause remains unknown. Manual approval workflow_dispatch was not tested. PR remains draft, open and stale-base.
records.methodology: GitHub Actions run/job evidence and current main/PR workflow source comparison.
records.limitations: A successful branch counterexample does not establish that main's zero-job failure is fixed. Do not claim invalid YAML as root cause.
